_comment: sim/input-noise as a `klt sim` request (issue #96): T1 item 5 coverage for the ratified input-referred-noise row.
Circuit: tb_noise.body.spice -- the same test circuit as ../testbench/tb_noise.spice.tmpl (unity-gain follower via Vfb, CL = 2 pF, 10 uA ibias, ac 1 on Vinp).
Grid: cornerMOSlv.lib mos_tt/ss/ff/sf/fs [DR-1] x {-40, 27, 125} C x VDD {1.08, 1.20, 1.32} V = 45 corners.
vinp sweeps WITH vdd by index (klt's supply_v semantics), so Vcm = VDD/2 at every corner, as in the harness.
Each process corner is a bundle carrying the template's fixed cornerCAP.lib cap_typ section.
Analysis: noise v(out) Vinp dec 20 100 1meg = the template's claimed band, 100 Hz - 1 MHz, 81 points. The band is part of the ratified number and is not changed here.
Ratified row: input-referred noise <= 108.9 uVrms worst-case [DR-2], integrated over 100 Hz - 1 MHz, CL = 2 pF (spec/target-spec.md section 2). Carried as inoise_int_vrms limits.max = 108.9e-6 V.
Integrated figure: `noise2.inoise_total` -- ngspice's already-square-rooted RMS volts over the swept band, the vector the harness reads (setplot noise2). Reached with an `expr`; no `.meas` is needed.

Spot densities: noise1.inoise_spectrum[0/20/40/60/80] = 100 Hz / 1 kHz / 10 kHz / 100 kHz / 1 MHz (V/sqrt(Hz)); the band_* / spot_f_* measurements assert the frequencies and the 81-point length, as the harness does, so index arithmetic is never trusted silently.

The harness's DC operating-point sanity and closed-loop-gain guard need a second analysis (op / ac) in the same corner; klt sim runs ONE analysis per corner, so they are not reproduced here and compare.py does not compare them.

Prototype status: the `expr` forms were exercised ONLY on a toy resistor divider (ngspice-42, klt 0.7.0): all 12 resolved to scalars. NOT run against the DUT: the OSDI preflight needs ngspice-46. See ../README.md.
options.timeout_s = 300 s per corner: the harness noise deck (op + two noise sweeps + ac) is seconds per point; this deck runs one 81-point noise sweep.
Solver tolerance: ngspice default, no .options reltol/abstol/vntol (DR-0005).
ngspice_init raises the printed digits only (measureprec for .meas, numdgt for expr); it changes no solver setting.
keep_artifacts is false so the committed envelope carries no host-absolute artifact paths.
